sitemap-parsed.eventDescription: One successfully parsed sitemap file: $5 per 1,000 files. Index files count. URL rows have a separate $0.10 per 1,000 fee. Empty sources and sources with no matching or new rows ARE charged for parsing. Invalid input, HTTP failures, malformed XML and duplicate source URLs are not charged. No start fee; compute and transfer are included. maxTotalChargeUsd is an Apify run option, not an input field. Work stops when the remaining budget cannot cover the next event.

url.eventDescription: One delivered URL row (keys id, url, lastmod, changefreq, priority, sitemap_url): $0.10 per 1,000 URLs, plus $0.005 per successfully parsed sitemap or index file. Filtered, excluded and duplicate rows are not charged as URLs. No start fee; compute and transfer included. 1,000 URLs from one file cost $0.105. maxTotalChargeUsd is an Apify run option; no URL is delivered beyond its charge limit.
